manglik_dosha.name: Manglik / Kuja Dosha
manglik_dosha.rule: Mars in houses 1, 2, 4, 7, 8, or 12 from Lagna, Moon, or Venus.

source_refs.detail: Kuja/Manglik placement rules; exact verse pending

notes: Widely published exception rules (Mars own/exalted sign, Jupiter drishti on Mars, Mars-Moon conjunction) are applied as convention-dependent weakening factors in 'net_severity'; raw 'severity' is unchanged.
Use this as a deterministic flag, not a final marriage judgement.

gandanta_dosha.name: Gandanta Dosha
gandanta_dosha.rule: Moon, Lagna, or Sun within one pada (3°20') of a water→fire sign junction: Ashlesha–Magha (Cancer/Leo), Jyeshtha–Moola (Scorpio/Sagittarius), Revati–Ashwini (Pisces/Aries).

source_refs.detail: Rashi/nakshatra sandhi affliction; exact verse pending
One-pada zone width and 0°48'/1°40' severity bands follow the common software convention; golden-chart validation pending

notes: Zone width (one pada on each side) and severity orbs are convention-dependent; some traditions use different spans for Moon vs Lagna.
Jyeshtha–Moola gandanta (Abhukta Mula) is traditionally treated as the most intense junction.

grahan_dosha.name: Grahan (Eclipse) Dosha
grahan_dosha.rule: Sun or Moon in the same sign as Rahu or Ketu; severity graded by orb (<5° strong, <10° moderate, else mild).

source_refs.detail: Same-sign conjunction definition with orb grading follows the common software convention; classical texts grade by eclipse proximity at birth

notes: Orb thresholds are convention-dependent; some traditions require birth near an actual eclipse rather than any luminary-node conjunction.
